description: Poll a crawl until it ends (completed, stopped, or failed) and return its status, its counts and the first 20 URLs (first_urls). For every result, call crawl_download (one file) or crawl_results (pages). A crawl that ends completed with no results and no error finished; it is not a failure (see crawl_get). If the wait runs out first, it returns the crawl with status running and a note: call crawl_wait again. A call that carries a progressToken gets a progress notification after each poll, with the status and counts.

timeout.description: Max wait in seconds (default 50). Many MCP clients cancel a call after 60 s.

name: crawl_wait
